title: Account
subtitle: Your profile, sign-in and security, workspaces and data.

profile.title: Profile
profile.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Cropped to a square.
profile.name: Name
profile.usernameHint: Optional. Sign in with it instead of your e-mail: English letters and digits, 3 to 30 characters.
profile.emailNote: We send a confirmation link to the new address and tell the old one.
profile.emailChanged: E-mail changed. Confirm it with the link we sent to the new address.

security.changed: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
security.neverChanged: Not changed since the account was created.
security.strengthHint: 12 or more characters; a short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
security.twoFactorText: After your password, we ask for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
security.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key by hand.
security.codesText: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe: they are shown only now.
security.codeOrRecovery: Code from the app, or a recovery code
security.signOutAllText: Signs out every browser and phone, this one included. You sign in again with your password.
security.signOutConfirm: Sign out on every device, this one included?

workspaces.title: Your workspaces
workspaces.leaveConfirm: Leave {name}? You lose access until someone invites you again.
workspaces.soleOwner: You are the only owner: make another member owner (Settings › Team) before you can leave.

notifications.title: E-mails we send you
notifications.securityText: When your password, e-mail or two-step sign-in changes.
notifications.productText: Scheduled reports, tips and news about new features.
notifications.inApp: In-app notifications and phone pushes come from each workspace.

data.exportText: Your profile, workspaces, API keys and connected apps, support conversations, notifications, the files you uploaded and your AI use, in one JSON file.
data.deleteText: Your name, e-mail, photo and password are erased, you leave every workspace, and your sessions, API keys and connected apps stop working. Invoices and audit records stay, without your personal data. This cannot be undone.
data.blockers: Before you can delete your account:
data.transfer: {name}: you are the only owner and others work in it. Make one of them owner (Settings › Team).
data.deleteWs: {name}: nobody else is in it. It will be deleted with everything in it.
data.superadmin: You are a platform administrator. If you are the last one, make someone else administrator first.

changePassword.title: Choose your own password
changePassword.text: An administrator gave you a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.

verify.title: Confirm your e-mail
verify.bad: This link has expired. Ask for a new one in your account.

login2fa.title: Two-step sign-in
login2fa.text: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login2fa.recoveryText: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works once.

impersonation.banner: You are viewing the app as {name} ({email}).
impersonation.limits: Nothing can be deleted and their password, e-mail and keys stay untouched. Every change is recorded with your name.

resetDone: Password saved. Sign in with it and your two-step code.

password.reset: Password reset with the e-mail link

cli.superadmin_granted: Made platform admin on the server
cli.superadmin_revoked: Platform admin removed on the server

admin.sign_out: Signed out everywhere by an admin
